title: How Quantization Shapes Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using probability-based metrics on counterfactual sentences (StereoSet, RedditBias), coreference resolution accuracy (WinoBias), multiple-choice question answering in ambiguous contexts (BBQ), decision-making fairness benchmarks (DiscrimEval, DT-Fairness), and toxicity/sentiment analysis of generated continuations (BOLD, DT-Toxicity).
